messages:
maria: Heads up — I found a persistent XSS in the admin console (deployments page) when the 'notes' field contains HTML. Repro steps below. :eyes: alex: can you paste a PoC? is this authenticated-only? maria: PoC (authenticated admin account required). Paste this into a deployment note and view the deployments list: ```
ClickMe
``` It executes when any admin views the list (the notes column renders innerHTML). sam: tagging @ops-oncall and @jess. Severity: high — persistent XSS in admin UI allows token exfil if session cookies not httpOnly. Affects all orgs with admin access. ops-oncall: rolling mitigation: turned off notes rendering on prod (feature flag notes_render=false) and added a temporary CSP header to block inline handlers. Deploying now. sec-bot: detection alert — multiple suspicious outbound callbacks seen to mal.example from prod between 10:12-10:15 UTC. IPs: 3.24.12.45. Correlation id: clf-7b9. jess: I opened a PR to sanitize notes with DOMPurify and to enforce text-only in the DB for legacy entries: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webapp/pull/5482 (WIP). Also adding unit tests. toni: we need to rotate admin sessions and force reauth for all admins. Also add an audit log entry for any notes edit. Who can run session invalidation? sam: I can trigger session rotate via admin tool. Will revoke sessions created before 2026-05-01T10:00Z. Also adding a workaround WAF rule to strip onload/onclick attributes in POST payloads to /api/deployments. alex: confirm we have no KMS/exposed secrets in notes. Maria, can you grep logs for any leaked tokens? maria: grepping now. Found three requests to our oauth callback with token-like strings referencing user ids 102, 118 between 10:13-10:16 UTC. Saving to secure channel. jess: PR ready for review. Will include migration to sanitize existing notes in-place and add DB constraint to reject tags. Plan to ship patch to canary in 30m, then prod in 1h after smoke tests. ops-oncall: canary deploy started at 10:40 UTC. Will monitor errors and SIEM for new exfil attempts. sam: post-incident actions: 1) deploy PR and enable notes_render=true only after verified sanitization, 2) add alert for outbound requests to unknown hosts from admin consoles, 3) add automated test to catch innerHTML usage in templates, 4) update runbook to include session rotation step. toni: filing compliance ticket for audit log retention and notifying legal about potential token disclosure. Also recommend rotating any client secrets used by integration bots that touched admin console. alex: good work. Once prod is clean, prepare an internal summary (what happened, scope, remediation, timeline). I'll handle comms to CISO and execs. maria: thanks all. will paste sanitized log excerpts to #incidents channel and mark affected users for outreach. :thumbsup:
